fact: A comparative study of Senegal, Benin, Côte d'Ivoire and Burkina Faso found that none of them yet has specific, comprehensive legislation dedicated to artificial intelligence.
title: Report on Inclusive and Responsible Artificial Intelligence in West Africa: A Comparative Analysis of Policy, Legal and Institutional Frameworks in Senegal, Benin, Côte d'Ivoire and Burkina Faso
